identity.name: Pilot's Watch Chronograph

case.bezel: fixed steel bezel with tachymeter scale

identity.one_liner: IWC's mid-size pilot's chronograph, sitting between the Mark line's simplicity and the Top Gun and Spitfire chronograph variants in case size and movement complexity.

narrative.story: The Pilot's Watch Chronograph continues IWC's Mark-line design vocabulary — black dial, oversized luminous markers, anti-magnetic inner-case principles — scaled up to a 43mm chronograph case with a day-date window and tachymeter bezel. It has served as IWC's volume pilot chronograph, positioned below the ceramic-case Top Gun and in-house-movement Spitfire chronograph variants in both price and movement architecture.
narrative.collector_notes: IWC has updated parts of its pilot chronograph range with newer in-house calibers alongside this cal. 79320-based reference; confirm the exact reference and movement generation before buying, since 'Pilot's Watch Chronograph' alone covers more than one movement architecture across the current catalog.
